hypothesis: Mutation should earn a spatial/tactical payoff rather than extra XP; a bounded death-area effect could reward lure/cluster play without inflating the economy.

systemic-gameplay and meaningful-choice research favors legible cost/benefit without a dominant option

reason: The intended stronger-but-more-valuable carrier property is no longer true after the accounting correction.
